summary: The note describes Vocea României, a Romanian reality singing competition broadcast on PRO TV and based on the original The Voice of Holland. It aims to find new singing talent from public auditions, open to singers aged 16 or over. Television viewers vote by telephone to choose the winner, who receives a €100.000 prize and a record deal with Universal Records. The note says there have been eight winners so far and lists them.
one_line: Vocea României is a Romanian reality singing competition on PRO TV, based on The Voice of Holland, with eight winners to date.
key_facts: Vocea României is a Romanian reality singing competition broadcast on PRO TV.
The English title of Vocea României is "The Voice of Romania".
Vocea României is based on the original "The Voice of Holland".
The concept of Vocea României is to find new singing talent.
Contestants in Vocea României are aspiring singers aged 16 or over, drawn from public auditions.
The winner of Vocea României is determined by television viewers voting by telephone.
The winner of Vocea României is entitled to a €100.000 prize.
The winner of Vocea României receives a record deal with Universal Records.
There have been eight winners of Vocea României to date.
The winners of Vocea României to date are Ștefan Stan, Julie Mayaya, Mihai Chițu, Tiberiu Albu, Cristina Bălan, Teodora Buciu, Ana Munteanu and Bogdan Ioan.
